Designation: Trompeta de admisión TWIN AIR Powertune
HtmlDescription:
• La nueva trompeta de admisión Twin Air aumenta la respuesta del acelerador y la potencia de gama media a alta en los últimos modelos 2021-2023 Honda CRF450R y 2022-2023 CRF250R.

Designation: Filtro de aire ignífugo TWIN AIR - 156083FR
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Third layer fire resistant foam laminated to the filter that allows to remove the stock backfire screen
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

Designation: Filtro de aire ignífugo TWIN AIR - 156061FR
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Third layer fire resistant foam laminated to the filter that allows to remove the stock backfire screen
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

Designation: Filtro de aire TWIN AIR - 158188
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

• Gracias a su concepción patentada y a sus materias primas de alta calidad, los filtros Twin Air garantizan el mejor rendimiento y protección para su moto. Por eso los fabricantes de OE y los mejores pilotos del mundo eligen Twin Air.
  • Filtro de aire ignífugo prelubricado.
  • La espuma gruesa de poro abierto atrapa la suciedad, la mugre y la arena del aire
  • La espuma interior de poro abierto fino actúa como un segundo filtro para atrapar las partículas más pequeñas al tiempo que garantiza el máximo paso de aire
  • Tercera capa de espuma resistente al fuego laminada al filtro que permite eliminar la pantalla de retroceso original
  • El adhesivo desarrollado exclusivamente garantiza que las costuras de pegado no se rompan
  • Anillo de sellado de espuma gruesa y plana, sin grasa, que asegura el máximo contacto con su caja de aire, a la vez que actúa como una junta transpirable para aumentar el paso del aire
  • Los elementos exteriores e interiores fusionados evitan que la suciedad y la mugre se alojen entre las capas, a diferencia de Twin Air, esto puede ser un problema con los diseños inferiores de dos piezas
  • Las partículas atrapadas pueden restringir el flujo de aire. Y si la suciedad se abre paso en el motor, un gránulo del tamaño de una cabeza de alfiler perforará el cilindro, el pistón y los segmentos como una bala

Designation: Filtro de aire TWIN AIR - 157002
HtmlDescription: • Gracias a su diseño patentado y a sus materiales de alta calidad, los filtros Twin Air garantizan unas prestaciones y un nivel de protección inigualables hasta hoy. Es por ello que fabricantes OE y los mejores pilotos del mundo eligen Twin Air. Filtro de aire estándar para el kit Twin Air Power Flow (ref. 791550).Una primera capa de espuma ventilada atrapa el polvo, la arena y las impurezas. Una segunda capa de espuma, más densa, detiene las partículas más finas al mismo tiempo que favorece el flujo de aire. El pegamento que une estas capas se ha desarrollado especialmente para los filtros Twin Air y asegura la fijación de las capas Los filtros Twin Air son más pequeños que los de fábrica para que puedas aumentar el volumen de la caja del flitro y favorecer el flujo de aire. Si la suciedad se cuela en el motor, basta con una partícula del tamaño de la cabeza de un alfiler para perforar el cilindro, el pistón y los segmentos.

Designation: Filtro de aire ignífugo TWIN AIR - 156087FR
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Replacement fire resistant air filter for the kit 797127
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Third layer fire resistant foam laminated to the filter that allows to remove the stock backfire screen
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

Designation: Filtro de aire TWIN AIR cilíndrico manguito Ø57mm - 158719
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

Designation: Filtro de aire TWIN AIR 156063P
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

Designation: Filtro de aire ignífugo TWIN AIR - 156016FR
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Third layer fire resistant foam laminated to the filter that allows to remove the stock backfire screen
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

Designation: Filtro de aire TWIN AIR - 158197
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

  • La junta, gruesa y plana, asegura el máximo contacto con la caja de aire si necesidad de grasa, al tiempo que actúa como una junta transpirable para un mayor paso de aire.

Designation: Filtro de aire ignífugo TWIN AIR - 152607FR
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Third layer fire resistant foam laminated to the filter that allows to remove the stock backfire screen
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

Designation: Filtro de aire TWIN AIR - 158268
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

Designation: Filtro de aire ignífugo TWIN AIR - 158013FR
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Third layer fire resistant foam laminated to the filter that allows to remove the stock backfire screen
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

Es por ello que fabricantes OE y los mejores pilotos del mundo eligen Twin Air. Filtro de aire estándar para el kit Twin Air Power Flow (ref. 791550).Una primera capa de espuma ventilada atrapa el polvo, la arena y las impurezas. Una segunda capa de espuma, más densa, detiene las partículas más finas al mismo tiempo que favorece el flujo de aire. El pegamento que une estas capas se ha desarrollado especialmente para los filtros Twin Air y asegura la fijación de las capas Los filtros Twin Air son más pequeños que los de fábrica para que puedas aumentar el volumen de la caja del flitro y favorecer el flujo de aire. El diseño exclusivo de la «junta transpirable» garantiza una superficie de contacto máxima con el cuerpo de la caja del filtro. Las partículas atrapadas pueden restringir el flujo de aire. Si la suciedad se cuela en el motor, basta con una partícula del tamaño de la cabeza de un alfiler para perforar el cilindro, el pistón y los segmentos.

Designation: Filtro de aire TWIN AIR 156149P
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

Designation: Filtro de aire TWIN AIR - 158196
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

Designation: Filtro de aire TWIN AIR - 158123
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

Designation: Filtro de aire TWIN AIR - 158263
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

Designation: Cubrefiltro de aire TWIN AIR Grand Prix Cover
HtmlDescription:
• Este sobrefiltro se ha diseñado para proteger el filtro de aire de tu moto en condiciones de mucho polvo y arena. Esta capa adicional de protección ayuda a mantener limpio el filtro de aire y prolonga los intervalos de mantenimiento, lo que resulta especialmente beneficioso en entornos exigentes. Se instala fácil y rápidamente.

  • Fácil instalación: la funda se coloca fácilmente sobre el filtro de aire, ofreciendo una protección inmediata.

Designation: Filtro de aire ignífugo TWIN AIR - 158270FR
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Replacement fire resistant air filter for the kit 797137
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Third layer fire resistant foam laminated to the filter that allows to remove the stock backfire screen
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

• Gracias a su diseño patentado y a sus materiales de alta calidad, los filtros Twin Air garantizan unas prestaciones y un nivel de protección inigualables hasta hoy. Es por ello que fabricantes OE y los mejores pilotos del mundo eligen Twin Air.
    Una primera capa de espuma ventilada atrapa el polvo, la arena y las impurezas. Una segunda capa de espuma, más densa, detiene las partículas más finas al mismo tiempo que favorece el flujo de aire. El pegamento que une estas capas se ha desarrollado especialmente para los filtros Twin Air y asegura la fijación de las capas Los filtros Twin Air son más pequeños que los de fábrica para que puedas aumentar el volumen de la caja del flitro y favorecer el flujo de aire. El diseño exclusivo de la «junta transpirable» garantiza una superficie de contacto máxima con el cuerpo de la caja del filtro. Las partículas atrapadas pueden restringir el flujo de aire. Si la suciedad se cuela en el motor, basta con una partícula del tamaño de la cabeza de un alfiler para perforar el cilindro, el pistón y los segmentos.

Designation: Filtro de aire TWIN AIR - 158320N
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet

Designation: Líquido refrigerante TWIN AIR Iceflow - 6x1 L
HtmlDescription:
• Twin Air Ha añadido a su oferta un novedoso y biodegradable líquido refrigerante de altas prestaciones para ser utilizado en carretera, campo o ATV/UTV.
  • IceFlow está preparado para ser usado y proteger los metales y partes que forman el sistema de refrigeración. El objetivo principal era lanzar un producto que soportara las condiciones Off Road más extremas y el uso On Road de todo el año, y todo ello cresperando al máximo la naturaleza.
  • Características:
  • Base de Monopropyleno glycol (mpg)
  • Tecnología de vanguardia nanotech y aditivo orgánico Biodegradable, no toxico.
  • Reduce la temperatura para obtener un funcionamiento óptimo.
  • Punto de congelación muy bajo, -26°
  • Gran protección contra la corrosión
  • No contine silicatos

Designation: Prefiltro de aire TWIN AIR Rain Coat
HtmlDescription:

Diseñados para encajar perfectamente sobre los filtros de aire Twin Air, estos prefiltros son ideales para condiciones de humedad intensa, barro y polvo, evitando que las partículas más finas lleguen al motor.

  • Fácil Instalación: Pueden ser montados fácilmente sobre los filtros de aire existentes de Twin Air, proporcionando una protección adicional sin complicaciones.

Designation: Filtro de aire TWIN AIR - 156026
HtmlDescription: • Gracias a su diseño patentado y a sus materiales de alta calidad, los filtros Twin Air garantizan unas prestaciones y un nivel de protección inigualables hasta hoy. Designation: Filtro de aire TWIN AIR pre-lubricado - 154011X
HtmlDescription:
• Gracias a su concepción patentada y a sus materias primas de alta calidad, los filtros Twin Air garantizan el mejor rendimiento y protección para su moto. Por eso los fabricantes de OE y los mejores pilotos del mundo eligen Twin Air.
  • Filtro de aire prelubricado.
  • La espuma gruesa de poro abierto atrapa la suciedad, la mugre y la arena del aire
  • La espuma interior de poro abierto fino actúa como un segundo filtro para atrapar las partículas más pequeñas al tiempo que garantiza el máximo paso de aire
  • Tercera capa de espuma resistente al fuego laminada al filtro que permite eliminar la pantalla de retroceso original
  • El adhesivo desarrollado exclusivamente garantiza que las costuras de pegado no se rompan
  • Anillo de sellado de espuma gruesa y plana, sin grasa, que asegura el máximo contacto con su caja de aire, a la vez que actúa como una junta transpirable para aumentar el paso del aire
  • Los elementos exteriores e interiores fusionados evitan que la suciedad y la mugre se alojen entre las capas, a diferencia de Twin Air, esto puede ser un problema con los diseños inferiores de dos piezas
  • Las partículas atrapadas pueden restringir el flujo de aire. Y si la suciedad se abre paso en el motor, un gránulo del tamaño de una cabeza de alfiler perforará el cilindro, el pistón y los segmentos como una bala

HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage

  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down

Designation: Filtro de aire TWIN AIR - 158210
HtmlDescription:
• Thanks to their patented conception and their high quality raw materials, Twin Air filters warrant the best performance and protection for your motorcycle. That’s why EO manufacturers and the best riders of the world choose Twin Air.
  • Coarse open-pore foam catches airborne dirt, grime and sand
  • Fine open-pore inner foam acts as a second filter to trap the smallest particles while ensuring maximum air passage
  • Third layer fire resistant foam laminated to the filter that allows to remove the stock backfire screen
  • Exclusively developed adhesive ensures glue seams will not break down
  • Thick, flat foam, greaseless sealing ring ensures maximum contact with your airbox, while acting as a breathable gasket for increased air passage
  • Fused outer and inner elements prevent dirt and grime from being lodged between layers, unlike Twin Air, this can be a problem with inferior two-piece designs.
  • Trapped particles can restrict airflow. And if dirt works its way into your engine, a pinhead-sized granule will gouge your cylinder, piston and rings like a bullet
